data.narrative:
Physical Intelligence, a Series B AI & Software company founded by Karol Hausman, Sergey Levine, Chelsea Finn, and Brian Ichter, is currently valued at $5.6B post-money following $600M+ in total capital raised. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 9 private peers and 1 public comparator (Palantir) operating in the same sector and stage proximity, including Figure AI ($39.0B, Series C), Reflection AI ($25.0B, Series A), Skild AI ($14.0B, Series C), Crusoe Energy ($10.0B, Series C), and Together AI ($8.3B, Series C).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis applied a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B-to-next-stage transitions to the $5.6B base, yielding $10.6B. Peer-median analysis across the 7-company same-sector, same/adjacent-stage sample produced a median of $10.0B, with a range of $2.0B to $39.0B. Both methods proved applicable to this Series B-stage asset.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $8.5B (low) to $12.2B (high), with a median of $10.3B. This implies modest upside from the current $5.6B post-money. Key uncertainties include the wide dispersion in peer valuations ($2.0B–$39.0B) and stage heterogeneity within the comp set, which constrains confidence in point estimates.
